name: Global Carbon Budget 2023 Data Package
model_or_instrument: Ensemble of DGVMs, GOBMs, bookkeeping models, atmospheric inversions, and ESMs
resolution: Annual and monthly, global and gridded (varying between 0.25° and ESM resolutions)

scales.note: Multi-component budget package spanning 1750-2023 with monthly to annual resolutions, global totals, and gridded products (from 0.25 deg up to GCM grids).
